main: Composite PNG overlays were exported for coarse, medium and high display scales.
Each composite combines the visible remote-sensing basemap with red pixel-level anomaly/support cells.
supporting: Coarse and medium composites use real NASA GIBS rendered basemaps.
The medium composite keeps the current VIIRS corrected-reflectance + weak-label learned mask path.
conflicting: Composite overlays are screenshot/PPT display assets, not sensor-native raster products.
The executed medium model is a local weak-label baseline, not Dust-Mamba or Element84 public weights.
The high-resolution composite uses a same-day Sentinel-2 COG thumbnail and remains supporting-only because no Sentinel-2 dust model ran.
precursor: Meteorology, aerosol and confounder evidence remain separate evidence-chain inputs, not part of the composite export.

display_policy: Use these composite PNGs as PPT-ready views of basemap + red pixel-level mask. Label the medium view as weak-label VIIRS inference and keep coarse/high support-only.
